fact: KSDS I (2019/20-2022/23) was evaluated in 2023 to inform design of KSDS II (2023/24-2027/28), whose mid-term review is planned for 2026.
title: The Second Kenya Strategy for Development of Statistics: An Agenda for Transformation and Modernization of Data and Statistics (FY 2023/24 - 2027/28)
